name: io.github.tonyyang0504/criteo-mcp
description: Criteo (Commerce Growth / Criteo GO) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_bu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CRITEO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of a Criteo Marketing Solutions app (Developer portal > app > Create new key), sent in the form body of POST https://api.criteo.com/oauth2/token (grant_type=client_credentials).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CRITEO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app key's secret. Tokens last 900 seconds and are re-requested automatically; the advertisers must have approved the app's consent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CRITEO_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: ISO 4217 currency for get_report (the statistics endpoint requires `currency`), e.g. EUR or USD.
